## Project Summary

**What it is:** A seven-day remediation planner for nursing students. Reads a JSON file of missed questions (with topic, client need, and why-missed notes), then generates a study schedule that spreads topics across days, pairs initial learning with later recall sessions, and emphasizes practical nurse (PN) scope—reinforce, monitor, report, and follow the care plan. Written in Python with standard library only.

**Rules (from CLAUDE.md):**
- Standard library only; no network, no database; plain JSON files only
- Must be openable in a text editor on a phone
- Never include actual question text from paid question banks (topic tags and own notes only)
- Everything must stay within PN scope of practice; fix any scope violations
